geometry: Inverted pentagon; Mind at centre; Ego at bottom
roles:
Five roles.
Mind at the centre.
Ego
A place-and-time pointer that traces the decision history shaped by Memory, Intellect, Sense, and Action.
Memory
Knowledge available to the Mind.
Intellect
Strategy for reasoning, choosing methods, and organizing the next step.
Sense
Observation of the environment and internal operations.
Action
End-to-end orchestration that carries intent through execution.

A conceptual framework: Ego acts as a pen nib while temporal flow carries the decision history.
pause: Gallery pause froze the trace; library control resumed both instances
egoNib: Touches the current endpoint of the moving decision-history trace
